```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(shinyWidgets)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(targets)

# Helper function to create consistent pickerInput
make_picker <- function(inputId, label, choices, selected = choices[1]) {
  pickerInput(
    inputId = inputId,
    label = label,
    choices = choices,
    selected = selected,
    multiple = TRUE,
    width = "100%",
    options = pickerOptions(
      actionsBox = TRUE,
      liveSearch = length(choices) > 10,
      selectedTextFormat = "count > 2",
      countSelectedText = "{0} selezionati",
      noneSelectedText = "Seleziona...",
      selectAllText = "Tutti",
      deselectAllText = "Nessuno",
      container = "body",
      size = 10
    )
  )
}

# 1. Load combined datasets (already merged from filtered + forecast) -----
tar_load(combined_534_50_M, store = "_targets")
tar_load(combined_534_49_M, store = "_targets")

# 2. Filter for base 2021 data -----
data_50 <- combined_534_50_M[grepl("base 2021", DATA_TYPE_label, ignore.case = TRUE)]
data_49 <- combined_534_49_M[grepl("base 2021", DATA_TYPE_label, ignore.case = TRUE)]

# 3. Keep only required columns (including forecast columns) -----
cols_base <- c("tempo", "valore", "type", "valore_forecast",
               "lower_80", "upper_80", "lower_95", "upper_95")
cols_dim <- c("DATA_TYPE_label", "ADJUSTMENT_label",
              "PROF_STATUS_EMP_label", "ECON_ACTIVITY_NACE_2007_label")
cols_to_keep <- c(cols_base, cols_dim)

# Keep only columns that exist
cols_50 <- intersect(cols_to_keep, names(data_50))
cols_49 <- intersect(cols_to_keep, names(data_49))

data_50 <- data_50[, ..cols_50]
data_49 <- data_49[, ..cols_49]

# 4. Add dataset identifier -----
data_50[, dataset := "534_50 - Occupazione"]
data_49[, dataset := "534_49 - Ore lavorate"]

# 5. Combine datasets -----
all_data <- rbindlist(list(data_50, data_49), use.names = TRUE)

# Ensure tempo is Date
if (!inherits(all_data$tempo, "Date")) {
  all_data[, tempo := as.Date(tempo)]
}

# Clean up
rm(combined_534_50_M, combined_534_49_M, data_50, data_49)
```

**Seleziona i filtri da sinistra a destra**

```{r}
# Dataset selector
selectInput("dataset", "Dataset:",
            choices = unique(all_data$dataset),
            selected = unique(all_data$dataset)[1])

# Forecast controls
checkboxInput("show_forecast", "Mostra previsioni", value = TRUE)

selectInput("ci_level", "Intervallo di confidenza:",
            choices = c("Nessuno" = "none", "80%" = "80", "95%" = "95"),
            selected = "95")

hr()

# Date range selector
dateRangeInput("date_range",
               "Intervallo date:",
               start = min(all_data$tempo),
               end = max(all_data$tempo),
               min = min(all_data$tempo),
               max = max(all_data$tempo),
               format = "yyyy-mm",
               separator = " - ",
               language = "it")

hr()

# DATA_TYPE selector (cascading)
uiOutput("data_type_ui")

# ADJUSTMENT selector (cascading)
uiOutput("adjustment_ui")

# PROF_STATUS selector (cascading)
uiOutput("prof_status_ui")

# ECON_ACTIVITY selector (cascading)
uiOutput("econ_activity_ui")

hr()

# Download controls
h5("Esporta")
selectInput("download_format", "Formato:", choices = c("PNG" = "png", "PDF" = "pdf"))
downloadButton("download_plot", "Scarica grafico", icon = icon("download"))
```

```{r context="server"}
# 1. Filtered data after dataset selection -----
data_after_dataset <- reactive({
  req(input$dataset)
  all_data[dataset == input$dataset]
})

# 2. DATA_TYPE dropdown -----
output$data_type_ui <- renderUI({
  choices <- sort(unique(data_after_dataset()$DATA_TYPE_label))
  make_picker("data_type", "Tipo di dato:", choices)
})

# 3. Filtered data after DATA_TYPE selection -----
data_after_data_type <- reactive({
  dt <- data_after_dataset()
  if (!is.null(input$data_type) && length(input$data_type) > 0) {
    dt <- dt[DATA_TYPE_label %in% input$data_type]
  }
  dt
})

# 4. ADJUSTMENT dropdown -----
output$adjustment_ui <- renderUI({
  req(input$data_type)
  choices <- sort(unique(data_after_data_type()$ADJUSTMENT_label))
  make_picker("adjustment", "Correzione:", choices)
})

# 5. Filtered data after ADJUSTMENT selection -----
data_after_adjustment <- reactive({
  dt <- data_after_data_type()
  if (!is.null(input$adjustment) && length(input$adjustment) > 0) {
    dt <- dt[ADJUSTMENT_label %in% input$adjustment]
  }
  dt
})

# 6. PROF_STATUS dropdown -----
output$prof_status_ui <- renderUI({
  req(input$adjustment)
  choices <- sort(unique(data_after_adjustment()$PROF_STATUS_EMP_label))
  make_picker("prof_status", "Posizione professionale:", choices)
})

# 7. Filtered data after PROF_STATUS selection -----
data_after_prof_status <- reactive({
  dt <- data_after_adjustment()
  if (!is.null(input$prof_status) && length(input$prof_status) > 0) {
    dt <- dt[PROF_STATUS_EMP_label %in% input$prof_status]
  }
  dt
})

# 8. ECON_ACTIVITY dropdown -----
output$econ_activity_ui <- renderUI({
  req(input$prof_status)
  choices <- sort(unique(data_after_prof_status()$ECON_ACTIVITY_NACE_2007_label))
  make_picker("econ_activity", "Attivita economica:", choices)
})

# 9. Final filtered data -----
filtered_data <- reactive({
  dt <- data_after_prof_status()
  if (!is.null(input$econ_activity) && length(input$econ_activity) > 0) {
    dt <- dt[ECON_ACTIVITY_NACE_2007_label %in% input$econ_activity]
  }
  # Apply date range filter
  if (!is.null(input$date_range)) {
    dt <- dt[tempo >= input$date_range[1] & tempo <= input$date_range[2]]
  }
  dt
})

# Reactive plot object for rendering and download
plot_object <- reactive({
  req(nrow(filtered_data()) > 0)

  plot_data <- filtered_data()[order(tempo)]

  # Build series identifier from columns with multiple selections
  series_cols <- c()
  if (!is.null(input$data_type) && length(input$data_type) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, "DATA_TYPE_label")
  }
  if (!is.null(input$adjustment) && length(input$adjustment) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, "ADJUSTMENT_label")
  }
  if (!is.null(input$prof_status) && length(input$prof_status) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, "PROF_STATUS_EMP_label")
  }
  if (!is.null(input$econ_activity) && length(input$econ_activity) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, "ECON_ACTIVITY_NACE_2007_label")
  }

  # Create series label column
  if (length(series_cols) > 0) {
    plot_data[, series := do.call(paste, c(.SD, sep = " - ")), .SDcols = series_cols]
  } else {
    plot_data[, series := "Serie"]
  }

  # Split historical and forecast data
  hist_data <- plot_data[type == "historical"]
  fc_data <- plot_data[type == "forecast"]

  # Create title from single selections
  if (length(input$data_type) == 1) {
    plot_title <- input$data_type
  } else {
    plot_title <- paste0(length(input$data_type), " tipi di dato")
  }

  if (length(input$econ_activity) == 1) {
    plot_title <- paste0(plot_title, "\n", input$econ_activity)
  }

  # Build subtitle from single selections
  subtitle_parts <- c()
  if (length(input$adjustment) == 1) {
    subtitle_parts <- c(subtitle_parts, input$adjustment)
  }
  if (length(input$prof_status) == 1) {
    subtitle_parts <- c(subtitle_parts, input$prof_status)
  }
  plot_subtitle <- paste(subtitle_parts, collapse = " - ")

  # Check if we have multiple series
  n_series <- length(unique(plot_data$series))

  if (n_series > 1) {
    # Multiple series: use color aesthetic
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_line(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore, color = series, group = series),
                linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore, color = series),
                 size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7)

    # Add forecast if enabled
    if (input$show_forecast && nrow(fc_data) > 0) {
      if (input$ci_level == "95" && "lower_95" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data,
                             aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95, fill = series, group = series),
                             alpha = 0.15)
      } else if (input$ci_level == "80" && "lower_80" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data,
                             aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_80, ymax = upper_80, fill = series, group = series),
                             alpha = 0.2)
      }

      p <- p +
        geom_line(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast, color = series, group = series),
                  linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
        geom_point(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast, color = series),
                   size = 1.5)
    }

    p <- p + labs(color = "Serie", fill = "Serie")

  } else {
    # Single series: use fixed colors
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_line(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore),
                color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore),
                 color = "#2c3e50", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7)

    if (input$show_forecast && nrow(fc_data) > 0) {
      if (input$ci_level == "95" && "lower_95" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data,
                             aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95),
                             fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.2)
      } else if (input$ci_level == "80" && "lower_80" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data,
                             aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_80, ymax = upper_80),
                             fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.3)
      }

      p <- p +
        geom_line(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast),
                  color = "#3498db", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
        geom_point(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast),
                   color = "#3498db", size = 1.5)
    }
  }

  p +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y-%m", date_breaks = "6 months") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format(decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = ".")) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      subtitle = plot_subtitle,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Valore",
      caption = paste("Dataset:", input$dataset)
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40", size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2), fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
})

# Download handler
output$download_plot <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    dataset_name <- gsub(" - .*$", "", input$dataset)
    timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    paste0("grafico_", dataset_name, "_", timestamp, ".", input$download_format)
  },
  content = function(file) {
    p <- plot_object()
    if (input$download_format == "png") {
      ggsave(file, plot = p, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    } else {
      ggsave(file, plot = p, width = 10, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf)
    }
  }
)
```

### Dati

```{r}
renderTable({
  req(nrow(filtered_data()) > 0)

  dt <- filtered_data()[order(-tempo)]

  # Show only historical if forecast disabled
  if (!input$show_forecast) {
    dt <- dt[type == "historical"]
  }

  result <- dt[, .(
    Data = format(tempo, "%Y-%m"),
    Valore = fifelse(
      type == "historical",
      format(round(valore, 2), decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = "."),
      paste0(format(round(valore_forecast, 2), decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = "."), " *")
    ),
    Tipo = fifelse(type == "historical", "Storico", "Previsione")
  )]

  head(result, 24)
}, striped = TRUE, hover = TRUE, spacing = "s")
```
